value.answer: Call 911 now - fever with purple spots that don't fade when pressed needs emergency care, even if your child seems okay. Don't wait to see if it spreads.
value.triage: Call 911 now. Don't wait for a callback from Health811 (811) - this is not an 811 situation. Tell the operator if your child is floppy, very drowsy, breathing fast, or has cold hands and feet.
